title: 1 Nuke vs 250,000 Pawns
summary: On a 1000x1000 board, the player's king and one 'Nuke' (queen + knightrider) face Martin's 250,000 black pawns (half of all squares) with Martin's king hidden at the very top.
rules: Black: king at the very top plus 250,000 pawns filling half of the squares (alternating/checkerboard pattern visible in frames).
White (player): king + one Nuke at the bottom.
Nuke moves like a queen OR a knightrider (repeated knight leaps in one direction, any distance).
Normal chess rules otherwise; Martin pawns promote on reaching the player's back rank.
